purpose: Human-reviewed Commander deck corpus for tuning and manually validating deck analysis.

expectations: Treat sacrifice outlets and recursion as meaningful engine pieces.
Do not count Saproling Symbiosis as a board wipe.
Treat a board wipe as contextual rather than the deck's automatic biggest weakness.
Surface conditional card flow separately from early direct access.

expectations: Do not penalize the deck for a lower creature count than generic midrange.
Recognize commander-centric protection and evasion as relevant support.
Keep board-wipe expectations low.
Reward cheap card flow and reactive interaction.
Do not mistake every instant-speed value spell for responsive interaction.
Accept a larger land count and land-recursion package.
Count extra-land effects and land ramp without treating every land as ramp.
Value responsive interaction and removal over creature count.
Do not expect an aggro-style board presence.
Recognize artifact mana and artifact-based draw engines.
Allow overlap between artifact synergy, ramp, and card flow.
Do not assume every enchantment deck is Enchantress.
Only credit enchantment-driven card flow when the cards actually provide it.
Separate life-gain payoffs from actual card flow, ramp, and removal.
Identify whether the deck has a concrete route from life total to victory.
Treat typal as a descriptive identity, not a universal scoring lens.
Recognize typal payoffs without inflating generic role counts.
Allow fewer lands and board wipes when fast mana, tutors, and interaction support a proactive win.
Weight tutors and reactive interaction more heavily than in casual profiles.
Do not classify self-blink as a board wipe.
Credit repeatable ETB engines only when they actually provide a role.
Treat commander combat damage and post-blocker pump as a coherent win plan.

Treat commander-generated treasure as conditional ramp.
Keep board wipes optional for this proactive strategy.
Separate conditional combat, cast-spell, targeting, and treasure card flow from early direct access.
